description: Writes ``src/MCEq/geometry/cutoff_maps.json``: for every site of :func:`MCEq.geometry.atmosphere_parameters.site_coordinates`, the effective cutoff R_eff in GV of downgoing protons on a 5° grid of zenith (0–90°) and azimuth (0–355°, arrival direction, 0° is from North, 90° from East). R_eff is the penumbra-resolved cutoff of Cooke et al. (1991): R_U minus the allowed rigidity bands below it. Each direction is traced from the point where its line of sight crosses 100 km altitude (the primary's entry into the atmosphere in the collinear 1D picture), with gtracr's penumbra mode, IGRF at :data:`MCEq.geometry.cutoff.CUTOFF_DATE`, the default rigidity-aware escape criterion and a 0.5 % rigidity ladder.
